kinds.label: Anthropic
kinds.summary: Claude, at Anthropic's own endpoint, with a key from console.anthropic.com.

kinds.label: OpenAI
kinds.summary: GPT, at OpenAI's own endpoint, with a key from platform.openai.com.

kinds.label: Ollama
kinds.summary: Models you run yourself, on an Ollama server on this computer or your network. No key, and nothing leaves that server.

kinds.label: OpenRouter
kinds.summary: Many vendors' models behind one key from openrouter.ai, each priced as OpenRouter lists it.

kinds.label: Azure OpenAI
kinds.summary: OpenAI's models in your own Azure resource, at its address, with its key. A model is a deployment's name.

kinds.label: Gemini
kinds.summary: Google's Gemini models, through the Gemini API, with a key from aistudio.google.com.

kinds.label: An OpenAI-compatible gateway
kinds.summary: Anything speaking Chat Completions at a URL of yours: vLLM, LM Studio, a company gateway. Some want no key.

kinds.label: A LiteLLM proxy
kinds.summary: A LiteLLM proxy at its URL. The one gateway that says what each model costs.
